plain: A model trained to score outputs, whose scores are then used to train or pick the answers of another model.
eli5: A robot teacher whose gold stars are what the robot student learns to chase.
technical: A learned proxy for human preference used as the optimisation target in RLHF or best-of-n sampling. Gao, Schulman and Hilton (2022): as optimisation against it grows, true (gold) reward rises, peaks and then falls.
